struck: The 7 percent applies only when the rent is above about $2,140 a month.
use: A $150 monthly minimum is more than 7 percent of any rent under about $2,140.

struck: About 1 in 4 rented houses gets a new tenant each year.
use: About 1 in 4 households renting a house here moved in within the past 12 months.

struck: A basic plan at about 13 to 17 percent takes about $3,300 to $4,500 of it.
use: If a basic plan's 13 to 17 percent is taken on all of it, that is about $3,300 to $4,500. The bookings include the cleaning fees guests pay.

struck: For 63 percent of them, the tax bill goes outside the Grand Strand.
use: For 63 percent of them, the tax bill goes to an address outside the area: outside Horry County's post-office ZIP codes and Pawleys Island.

struck: 261 mailing addresses receive 10 or more of these tax bills each (timeshare and resort companies, builders, large landlords, managers).
use: 261 mailing addresses receive 10 or more of these tax bills each, 10,827 homes in all.

struck: In an oceanfront building, a rental desk is usually there.
use: In oceanfront buildings, about 8 in 10 condos for sale list a vacation rental program.

struck: Every licensed manager works under a manager-in-charge, who answers for the trust account.
use: Every licensed manager works under a broker-in-charge or a property manager-in-charge, who answers for the trust account where the tenant's deposit sits.

pattern: \b30 days after the tenancy ends and the tenant asks\b
struck: within 30 days after the tenancy ends and the tenant asks, whichever is later
use: within 30 days after the tenancy ends, the tenant hands back the home and asks for the deposit, whichever is later

struck: A manager who signs a lease without telling becomes your agent for that lease.
use: A manager who signs a lease without giving that notice takes on the landlord's duties for that lease and receives the tenant's notices and legal papers.

struck: An owner who books a guest directly needs a state retail licence.
use: An owner who books guests directly needs a state retail licence, unless the home is rented no more than one week in each calendar quarter.

pattern: \bmanager'?s (?:share|fee|fees|cut)\b[^.]{0,60}\b(?:not on the guest'?s bill|count as part of the rent)\b
struck: The manager's share is not on the guest's bill: the tax is on what the guest pays.
use: The manager collects the tax on the full amount of the booking.
